title: Reading Practice Test 14 – Customer Relations
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: phiếu góp ý, thư chương trình khách hàng thân thiết, bài báo có chèn câu, ba đoạn liên kết). Chủ đề: chăm sóc khách hàng, khiếu nại, bảo hành.

questions.content: We ------- your feedback and will use it to improve our services.
questions.explanation: Sau chủ ngữ 'We' cần động từ → 'appreciate' (trân trọng).

questions.content: The customer service center handles more than 2,000 calls ------- day.
questions.explanation: 'each + danh từ số ít' → 'each day' (mỗi ngày).

questions.content: Ms. Ito responded to the complaint ------- and politely.
questions.explanation: Song song với trạng từ 'politely', bổ nghĩa cho 'responded' → 'promptly' (nhanh chóng).

questions.content: Customers who are ------- with their purchase may return it within 30 days.
questions.explanation: Cảm xúc của người → tính từ -ed: 'be dissatisfied with' (không hài lòng với).

questions.content: The new return policy will take ------- on January 1.
questions.explanation: Cụm cố định 'take effect' = có hiệu lực. 'affect' là động từ.

questions.content: Please keep your order number ------- you need to contact us about your purchase.
questions.explanation: 'in case' = phòng khi (bạn cần liên hệ).

questions.content: The company's customer satisfaction scores have improved ------- since it introduced 24-hour chat support.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'have improved' → trạng từ 'steadily' (đều đặn).

questions.content: All customer complaints must be handled ------- company guidelines.
questions.explanation: 'in accordance with' = theo đúng (quy định). 'on behalf of' = thay mặt; 'in charge of' = phụ trách.

questions.content: The representative to ------- Mr. Russo spoke yesterday has been promoted to team leader.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ 'to', đại từ quan hệ chỉ người phải là 'whom'. 'who' và 'that' không đứng sau giới từ.

questions.content: Our goal is to resolve every customer issue as ------- as possible.
questions.explanation: 'as … as possible' bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'resolve' → trạng từ nguyên dạng 'quickly'.

groups.passage:
Dear Mr. Hughes,

Thank you for contacting us about your recent stay at the Coral Bay Resort. We were very sorry to learn that the air-conditioning in your room was not working ---131--- your first night.

We have spoken with our maintenance team, and the unit ---132--- been repaired. ---133---.

As an apology, we would like to offer you a complimentary two-night stay, which can be used at any time within the next twelve months. To ---134--- this offer, simply mention the reference code CB2291 when making your reservation.

We hope to welcome you back soon.

Sincerely,
Maria Lopez
Guest Relations Manager

questions.explanation: 'during + cụm danh từ' (your first night) = trong suốt đêm đầu tiên. 'while' cần mệnh đề.
Chủ ngữ số ít 'the unit' + 'been repaired' → hiện tại hoàn thành bị động 'has been repaired'.

options.C: We have also inspected the other units on your floor.
options.D: Please pay your bill at checkout.

questions.explanation: Tiếp nối việc sửa máy lạnh → câu chèn nói thêm biện pháp: đã kiểm tra các máy khác trên cùng tầng.
'To + V nguyên mẫu' chỉ mục đích → 'To redeem this offer' (để sử dụng ưu đãi).

groups.passage:
We'd love to hear from you!
Thank you for dining at Luna Bistro. Please take a moment to rate your experience.

Food quality: ★★★★★
Service: ★★★☆☆
Cleanliness: ★★★★☆

Comments: The pasta was excellent, but we waited almost 20 minutes for our server to take our order. The restaurant was very busy.

Name (optional): Grace Wu

Complete this card and receive 10% off your next visit!

questions.content: What did Ms. Wu rate most highly?
questions.explanation: Chất lượng món ăn được 5 sao – cao nhất; cô cũng khen 'The pasta was excellent'.

questions.content: What does Ms. Wu mention about her visit?

options.A: She had to wait a long time to order.
options.D: She paid too much for her meal.

questions.explanation: 'We waited almost 20 minutes for our server to take our order.'

groups.passage:
Dear Valued Member,

We are writing to inform you about changes to the StarMiles loyalty program, which will take effect on July 1.

First, members will now earn 2 points for every dollar spent, up from 1 point. Second, points will expire after 24 months of account inactivity instead of 12 months. Finally, members who reach Gold status will receive free seat upgrades when available.

Your current point balance will not be affected by these changes. You can view your balance and redeem points on our Web site or mobile app.

Thank you for flying with us.

StarMiles Member Services

questions.content: What is the purpose of the letter?

options.C: To describe updates to a rewards program

questions.explanation: Thông báo các thay đổi của chương trình khách hàng thân thiết StarMiles.

questions.content: What is NOT mentioned as a change to the program?

options.D: Members will get free checked bags.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi NOT: thư không nhắc tới hành lý ký gửi miễn phí.

questions.content: What is indicated about members' existing points?

options.D: They must be redeemed by phone.

questions.explanation: 'Your current point balance will not be affected by these changes.'

groups.passage:
The Human Touch Still Matters
By Oliver Grant

As more companies use chatbots to answer customer questions, a new survey suggests that customers still value speaking with real people. [1] The survey of 3,000 consumers, conducted by the Customer Experience Council, found that 64 percent prefer to talk to a person when dealing with complicated problems.

However, chatbots remain popular for simple tasks, such as tracking an order or resetting a password. [2] Many customers appreciate that chatbots are available 24 hours a day and can respond instantly.

Experts recommend a combined approach. [3] "The best companies use technology to handle routine requests, which frees their staff to focus on more complex issues," said council director Amina Yusuf. [4]

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.B: What customers want from customer service

questions.explanation: Bài viết về mong muốn của khách hàng: vẫn cần người thật cho vấn đề phức tạp, dùng chatbot cho việc đơn giản.

questions.content: According to the survey, when do most customers prefer speaking to a person?
questions.explanation: '64 percent prefer to talk to a person when dealing with complicated problems.' (A), (B) là việc dùng chatbot.

questions.content: The word "frees" in paragraph 3, line 3, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'frees their staff to focus on…' = giúp nhân viên rảnh tay để tập trung → allows.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"For example, customers should be able to switch from a chatbot to a human agent at any time."
questions.explanation: 'For example' minh hoạ cho 'a combined approach' (kết hợp chatbot và người thật) ngay trước đó → vị trí [3].

groups.passage:
Brio Coffee Machines – Limited Warranty

Brio coffee machines are covered for two years from the date of purchase against defects in materials and workmanship. During this period, Brio will repair or replace the machine at no charge.

The warranty does not cover:
• Damage caused by using the machine with unapproved accessories
• Normal wear of parts such as filters and seals
• Machines purchased from unauthorized sellers

To make a claim, customers must provide proof of purchase.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: support@briocoffee.com
From: Nathan Clarke
Date: September 10
Subject: Broken coffee machine

Hello,

My Brio Classic coffee machine stopped heating water last week. I bought it at Home Plus Appliances in March of last year, so I believe it is still under warranty. I have attached a photo of my receipt.

I use the machine every day, and I have always used Brio's own filters. Please let me know what I should do next.

Regards,
Nathan Clarke

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: Nathan Clarke
From: Brio Customer Support
Date: September 11
Subject: RE: Broken coffee machine

Dear Mr. Clarke,

Thank you for contacting us. We have confirmed that your machine is covered by our warranty. Home Plus Appliances is one of our authorized retailers.

We will send you a prepaid shipping label by e-mail today. Please pack the machine securely and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, our technicians will repair it within ten business days. If the machine cannot be repaired, we will send you a new one.

Sincerely,
Ellen Park
Brio Customer Support

questions.content: What is NOT covered by the warranty?
questions.explanation: Bảo hành không áp dụng cho 'Normal wear of parts such as filters and seals'.

questions.content: What problem does Mr. Clarke report?

options.A: The machine makes too much noise.
options.C: The machine no longer heats water.

questions.explanation: 'My Brio Classic coffee machine stopped heating water last week.'

questions.content: What is suggested about Mr. Clarke's machine?

options.B: It is still within the warranty period.
options.C: It was used with other brands' filters.

questions.explanation: Mua tháng 3 năm ngoái, nay là tháng 9 → khoảng 1,5 năm, vẫn trong bảo hành 2 năm; phản hồi của Brio cũng xác nhận.

questions.content: What does Ms. Park confirm about Home Plus Appliances?

options.D: It is approved to sell Brio products.

questions.explanation: 'Home Plus Appliances is one of our authorized retailers' – điều kiện quan trọng vì bảo hành không áp dụng cho nơi bán không được uỷ quyền.

questions.content: What is Mr. Clarke asked to do?

options.A: Mail the machine using a prepaid label
options.B: Take the machine to Home Plus Appliances
options.D: Send the original receipt by mail

questions.explanation: Brio gửi nhãn vận chuyển trả trước; anh cần đóng gói máy và gửi tại bưu điện.
